ui.title: Loading and session check · smoke · Page entry and navigation
ui.preconditions: Signed-out visitor or controlled identity-provider state; backing data Client session and Keycloak OIDC initialization.
steps: Load the Nexora app entry route.
Open Nexora One and verify the brand splash and session-check progress indicator.
Check the page-specific heading and primary control and confirm no private data is exposed to the wrong account.
ui.expected: The Loading and session check lifecycle screen behaves as expected: Open Nexora One and verify the brand splash and session-check progress indicator. No unauthorized workspace data is displayed.
ui.evidence: Capture screenshot on failure; retain Playwright video and trace on failure.

bdd.scenario: Loading and session check: a visitor opens Nexora One
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a visitor opens Nexora One
bdd.then: Then the branded loading state appears while session status is checked
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Client session and Keycloak OIDC initialization and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Loading and session check: the identity session is valid
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When the identity session is valid
bdd.then: Then the visitor is routed to their authorized workspace
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Client session and Keycloak OIDC initialization and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Loading and session check: the identity session is absent
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When the identity session is absent
bdd.then: Then the sign-in screen appears after initialization
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Client session and Keycloak OIDC initialization and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Loading and session check: the session check is still pending
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When the session check is still pending
bdd.then: Then the loading progress remains visible without flashing private content
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Client session and Keycloak OIDC initialization and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.
